description_used: The interaction time falls within the allowable appeal period for the claim with ID "{claim_id}" of the user "{username}". The appeal period starts from the claim date and extends for {appeal_period} days after the claim date. Both interaction time and claim date are ISO 8601 formatted strings and are considered as date-time values.
